youtube.title: How Much House Can You Really Afford? #Shorts
youtube.description:
Your bank's mortgage approval is not your budget. The 28/36 rule shows how much house you can really afford on $60K, $100K or $150K a year at today's mortgage rates.

• 30-year fixed rate: 7.28% average as of Nov 19, 2026 (Freddie Mac PMMS)
• Lenders can allow a debt-to-income ratio up to 50% (Fannie Mae Selling Guide B3-6-02)
• 28% rule: about $189K on $60K, $315K on $100K, $472K on $150K
• Assumes 10% down, 30-year fixed at 7.28%, taxes + insurance ~1.5% of price per year. Estimates only.

Full breakdown with the hidden costs on the channel: "How Much House Can You Really Afford? ($60K, $100K, $150K)".

📌 Educational content only, not financial advice.
